caption: Sleep is not rest sleep is repair #sleep #sleeping #sleepbetterlivebetter
transcript: Sleep is not rest. Sleep is repair. When you sleep, the brain washes itself. It clears what you no longer need. When sleep is short, blood flow to the brain slows. Judgment weakens. Choices become heavy. Mistakes feel easier. Many harms the brain quietly. Sleeping less than seven hours. Forcing sleep with pills. Snoring loudly. Stopping breath in the night. These things strain the mind, even if you do not feel it yet. This is why sleep is sacred. When you sleep well, you think clearly. When you think clearly, memory strengthens. Tomorrow improves because tonight was respected. You do not improve life by pushing harder. You improve life by resting deeper. Stay with me. I will show you how to sleep better. Starting tonight. Follow and return to the body's natural rhythm.
